metadata.title: $φ$-symmetric Sasakian Lie algebras
metadata.abstract: We study Sasakian Lie algebras with trivial centre for which the adjoint operator $\mathrm{ad}_\xi$ associated to the Reeb vector field $\xi$ has two-dimensional image. Their structure is governed by a Kähler-exact Lie algebra $\mathfrak{h}_1$ and a vector $H_0\in\mathfrak{h}_1$, and the cases $H_0=0$ and $H_0\neq0$ are of a different nature. For $H_0=0$ we prove that the Sasakian structure is $\varphi$-symmetric if and only if $\mathfrak{h}_1$ is locally symmetric. For $H_0\neq0$ and $\mathfrak{h}_1$ solvable, we prove that it is $\varphi$-symmetric if and only if $\mathfrak{h}_1$ is locally symmetric and a natural two-form $\rho_0$ on $\mathfrak{h}_1$ determined by $H_0$ is parallel. The latter condition is equivalent to the vanishing of the mixed root spaces attached to the distinguished root selected by $H_0$ in the associated normal $j$-algebra. As a consequence, every Sasakian Lie algebra in this class of dimension at most seven is $\varphi$-symmetric, which extends a result of Loiudice and Lotta in dimension five. This bound is sharp: in dimension nine we exhibit a Sasakian structure which is not $\varphi$-symmetric, even though its Kähler base is locally symmetric.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Sasakian 李代数的 φ 对称判据
analysis.workSummary: 研究中心平凡且 Reeb 元伴随算子像为二维的 Sasakian 李代数，以 Kähler-exact 李代数 h₁ 与向量 H₀ 编码。H₀=0 时，φ 对称等价于 h₁ 局部对称。H₀≠0 且 h₁ 可解时，还需 H₀ 决定的自然二形式 ρ₀ 平行，等价于相关 normal j-algebra 中指定混合根空间消失。
analysis.breakthrough: 此类维数至多七的结构均为 φ 对称。九维例即使 Kähler 基局部对称仍失败，给出尖锐维数界。
analysis.limitations: 非零 H₀ 分支的充要判据保留 h₁ 可解假设。维数界属于中心平凡、伴随算子秩二的指定类别。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
